name: ORYVIA Face Wash with Aloe Vera, Niacinamide & Vitamin C
short_description: Refresh your skincare routine with ORYVIA Face Wash. Its refreshing cleansing formula helps remove everyday dirt and excess oil, leaving your skin feeling clean, fresh and comfortable.
description:
Give your daily skincare routine a refreshing start with ORYVIA Face Wash, a facial cleanser designed to remove everyday impurities and excess oil while leaving your skin feeling clean and refreshed.

Enriched with Aloe Vera, Niacinamide and Vitamin C, this face wash brings together popular skincare ingredients in a convenient pump bottle for everyday cleansing.

Key Features

  • Everyday cleansing: Helps remove dirt and excess oil from the skin.
  • Aloe Vera: A popular skincare ingredient known for its soothing and moisturising properties.
  • Niacinamide: A skincare ingredient commonly used to support the skin barrier and improve the appearance of uneven skin texture.
  • Vitamin C: An antioxidant ingredient commonly used in skincare for a brighter-looking complexion.
  • Convenient packaging: Pump dispenser for easy application.
  • Daily skincare routine: Suitable for incorporating into your regular cleansing routine, subject to the product’s directions.

How to Use

  1. Wet your face with clean water.
  2. Dispense a small amount of face wash into your palm.
  3. Gently massage over your face, avoiding the eyes.
  4. Rinse thoroughly with water and pat dry.

Product Details

  • Brand: ORYVIA
  • Product: Face Wash
  • Net Quantity: 200 ml
  • Key Ingredients Highlighted: Aloe Vera, Niacinamide and Vitamin C
  • Packaging: Pump bottle

Precautions

For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Check the product packaging for the complete ingredient list, directions, batch details and expiry date.

Make ORYVIA Face Wash a refreshing part of your daily skincare routine.
